entries.reason: Any function agreeing with odd-cycle parity on every nonzero scalar has Fourier support at least n-1. A pointwise product A*B has Fourier support inside S_A+S_B, so |S_A||S_B|>=n-1. This forces separately charged leaf support at least ceil(2*sqrt(n-1)) and a shared-dictionary pair-cover of root scale.
entries.reopen_condition: Use a deeper nonlinear circuit, modular composition, recurrence compression, or another implicit representation that is not one bilinear gate over expanded sparse character leaves.
entries.scope: One pointwise product of two exact additive-character sums whose output equals g_G(Q)J_G(x(Q))=(-1)^k for every nonzero secp256k1 scalar. The identity value is free.

entries.reason: A/B parity agreement gives A=sigma*B+d*delta_0. On frequencies outside S_A, the coefficients of B and d satisfy a Cauchy system with nodes zeta^(-r), zeta^s, and 0. Every square minor is nonzero, so |S_A|+|S_B|>=n. Even charging the union once gives |S_A union S_B|>=(n+1)/2.
entries.reopen_condition: Use a nonlinear implicit-spectrum circuit, modular composition, transposed evaluation, recurrence compression, p-adic or theta evaluation, elliptic units, or another representation not expressible as one sparse character quotient.
entries.scope: A quotient A(k)/B(k) of exact additive-character sums, with B(k) nonzero and quotient equal to g_G(Q)J_G(x(Q))=(-1)^k for every nonzero secp256k1 scalar. Coefficients are arbitrary complex values and the identity value is free.

global_warning: These are representation-specific expanded-support lower bounds. They are not unrestricted arithmetic-circuit or ECDLP lower bounds.
